caseName: Territory of the Virgin Islands v. United Indus. ex rel. Bason
caseNameFull: Territory of the VIRGIN ISLANDS v. UNITED INDUSTRIAL, SERVICE, TRANSPORTATION, PROFESSIONAL AND GOVERNMENT WORKERS OF NORTH AMERICA SEAFARERS INTERNATIONAL UNION, on Behalf of Ernest BASON.

opinions.text: Motion of Office of the Territorial Public Defender for leave to file a brief as amicus curiaegranted. Petition for writ of certiorari *1735to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
